name: Nautical Themes
description: Three nautical themes with light/dark palettes and matching backgrounds.

themes.name: Chart Room
themes.description: Ivory parchment and teal cartography by day; midnight navy and brass navigation by night.

themes.name: Captain’s Quarters
themes.description: Sunlit oak, cream and sea blue by day; lantern-lit walnut, amber and deep ocean by night.

themes.name: Signal Flags
themes.description: Crisp sailcloth, navy and signal red by day; deep admiralty blue and golden halyards by night.
